"""Retain exact declaration members from six already pinned, freshly SRI-verified archives."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,gzip,tarfile,base64
ROOT=Path('/home/parallels/.codex/worktrees/codex-closeout-main/ngx-compat-material-legacy')
ARCHIVES=Path('/tmp/closeout-configurable-sort-tree-20261015-m02wodg4')
SELECTION=json.loads((ROOT/'compatibility/rc/public-literal-types-worksheet.json').read_text())['selection']
ORIGINAL=json.loads((ROOT/'reference/material-16.2.14/environment-package-lock.json').read_text())['packages']
PEERS=json.loads((ARCHIVES/'peer-sources/identities.json').read_text())
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
SUBJECTS=[];PACKAGES=[];total=0
for line in ['original','main','21.x']:
    for package in ['@angular/cdk','@angular/material']:
        if line=='original':
            version='16.2.14';lock=ORIGINAL['node_modules/'+package]
            expected=next(p for p in json.loads((ARCHIVES/'reference16/source-identities.json').read_text())['packages'] if p['package']==package)
            integrity=lock['integrity'];digest=expected['archive_sha256'];path=ARCHIVES/'reference16/archives'/(package.replace('/','__')+'.tgz')
        else:
            expected=next(p for p in PEERS[line] if p['package']==package);version=expected['version'];integrity=expected['integrity'];digest=expected['archive_sha256'];path=ARCHIVES/'peer-sources'/line/'archives'/(package.replace('/','__')+'.tgz')
        raw=path.read_bytes();assert sha(raw)==digest;assert 'sha512-'+base64.b64encode(hashlib.sha512(raw).digest()).decode()==integrity
        with tarfile.open(path) as archive:
            pkg_raw=archive.extractfile('package/package.json').read();pkg=json.loads(pkg_raw);assert pkg['name']==package and pkg['version']==version
            refs={}
            def retain(member):
                global total
                if member in refs:return refs[member]
                info=archive.getmember(member);assert info.isfile();data=archive.extractfile(info).read();assert member.startswith('package/') and '..' not in member.split('/')
                target=Path('compatibility/rc/public-literal-types-sources')/line.replace('.','-')/package.split('/')[-1]/(member.removeprefix('package/').replace('/','--')+'.gz')
                assert not (ROOT/target).exists();(ROOT/target).parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);stored=gzip.compress(data,mtime=0);(ROOT/target).write_bytes(stored)
                refs[member]={'path':target.as_posix(),'archive_member':member,'sha256':sha(data),'bytes':len(data),'gzip_sha256':sha(stored)};total+=1;return refs[member]
            manifest=retain('package/package.json');license=retain('package/LICENSE')
            for module,names in SELECTION.items():
                if not module.startswith(package+'/'):continue
                family=module.split('/')[-1];entry='package/'+pkg['exports']['./'+family]['types'].removeprefix('./')
                source=entry if line=='original' or family not in ['a11y','dialog','progress-spinner'] else 'package/types/_'+family+'-module-chunk.d.ts' if family=='a11y' else 'package/types/_'+family+'-chunk.d.ts'
                legacy='package/legacy-'+family+'/index.d.ts' if line=='original' and family in ['dialog','progress-bar','progress-spinner','snack-bar','tabs','tooltip'] else None
                SUBJECTS.append({'line':line,'package':package,'version':version,'module':module,'symbols':names,'entry':retain(entry),'source':retain(source),'original_legacy_entry':retain(legacy) if legacy else None})
            PACKAGES.append({'line':line,'package':package,'version':version,'integrity':integrity,'archive_sha256':digest,'archive_bytes':len(raw),'archive_sri_verified':True,'manifest':manifest,'license':license})
CAPSULE={'schema_version':1,'role':'Complete original/minimum public declaration entries and type targets for eleven self-contained aliases. Partial extracted aliases are type fixtures only; no other peer member or runtime is qualified.','packages':PACKAGES,'subjects':SUBJECTS}
p=ROOT/'compatibility/rc/public-literal-types-declaration-subjects.json';assert not p.exists();p.write_text(json.dumps(CAPSULE,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'packages_sri_verified':6,'public_module_subjects':len(SUBJECTS),'alias_subjects':sum(len(s['symbols']) for s in SUBJECTS),'retained_members':total,'capsule_sha256':sha(p.read_bytes())}))
